articles.title: South Korea – A Cautionary Tale for the Rest of Humanity
articles.summary: South Korea is grappling with the world's lowest fertility rate, leading to an optimistic projection of its population shrinking by over two-thirds within the next century. This severe demographic crisis poses significant long-term challenges for the nation's economy, workforce, and overall societal structure, highlighting a critical international issue impacting national sustainability and global demographic trends.

articles.title: ISRO to launch 6.5-tonne BlueBird-6, its biggest US commercial payload
articles.summary: ISRO is set to launch the 6.5-tonne BlueBird-6 commercial communication satellite on December 15. Built by AST SpaceMobile, this mission will mark the heaviest American satellite ever launched by the Indian space agency. This significant event underscores India's formidable capabilities in the global commercial space market and its advanced technological prowess, further solidifying its position as a key player in space exploration and services.

articles.title: Airtel leads as India's stock market creates Rs 148 lakh crore wealth in 5 years: Motilal Oswal study
articles.summary: India's top 100 wealth creators significantly outperformed the Sensex, achieving a 38% Compound Annual Growth Rate over five years, compared to the Sensex's 21%. Motilal Oswal's study highlights this as the fastest wealth-creation period in three decades. This strong economic performance underscores India's dynamic market and potential for growth, relevant for understanding national economic trends and opportunities.
